# Linearity

> > Linearity provides professional design and animation software including Linearity Curve (vector design) and Linearity Move (motion graphics) for iPad and desktop.

The platform offers comprehensive tutorials, templates, and resources for designers, animators, and marketers to create vector graphics, animations, and motion content. Features include Auto Trace for converting sketches to vectors, and specialized tools for brand design, video marketing, and digital illustration workflows.

## Key Topics

- Linearity Curve
- Linearity Move
- Auto Trace
- Motion graphics
- Vector design
- 2D animation
- iPad design tools
- Apple Pencil
- Brand identity
- Video marketing
- Digital illustration
- Design tutorials
- Creative workflow
- Template library

- [Linearity: Ideate, Design, Animate | Linearity](https://www.linearity.io/templates): Template library for Linearity Curve and Move design assets
